text: The first discriminator is conclusive and the answer is none of C1, C2 or C3: it is an unsealed ambient host clock inside production branch predicates. Walking the first divergence rather than the aggregate: the metered traces are identical entry for entry, including virtual instants, until index 249, where the same dispatch on node-0 is due at 1789295948195 cold and 1789295948198 warm. A 3 ms difference in a virtual due time means a charge differed, and the first differing charge is a single rebalancer segment batch at instant 948023 on node-0, 1521 segments cold against 1550 warm. Diffing the resources created inside that one pass names the first divergent branch exactly: the warm run performs one extra authoritative incomplete-operations read through rebalance-coordinator-operation-read-methods.js:73 into replica-operation-repository-incomplete-read-methods.js:365, and thence through the gateway read dispatch and the CDC authoritative read flow. That file reads Date.now() six times, one of them the predicate nextIncompleteOperationSqlRetryAtMs > Date.now(), and the repository has a random seam but no clock seam. The decisive experiment: with the ambient wall clock made deterministic, cold run 1 equals warm runs 2 and 3 exactly, 411 entries and identical traces. A census of one simulation shows the scope: 28 distinct production Date.now() sites reached, 812 ambient clock reads. The deterministic-mode guard covers owner PASS bodies only, through guardedDispatch, and not the scheduler dispatch path, which is where all 812 reads happen. So the substrate's determinism hole is exactly the size of the unguarded dispatch path, and cold-versus-warm divergence is host execution speed reaching production staleness and backoff thresholds.

Owner decision 2026-09-19: never sealed, so it cannot land, and simulator work narrows. Its one finding named the cause it was opened to find - an unsealed ambient host clock in production branch predicates on the scheduler dispatch path (28 sites, 812 reads in one simulation). That cause was closed by formation-sim-production-time-authority-closure, which landed record-only with its probe at 0; the substrate work is on main in 22420f874. Nothing remains for this quest to do.
